questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'. **

I want you to (1)/ write an essay (2)/ which will be include in the journal. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error is in (3) '*which will be include in the journal'*.
 
• It should be **which will be included **instead.
 
• The sentence indicates that the action *will* have been completed (finished or "perfected") at some point in the future.
 
• Thus, we use **future tense in passive voice because the doer of the verb 'include' is somebody else hence, we need to use a passive voice.**
 
• So, the correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**

Therefore the** correct sentence** is-** *** 'I want you to write an essay which will be included in the journal.'*

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect Speech. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/Direct Speech. **

Pooja said, “I write novels.”

options.text: Pooja said that she wrote novels.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '__**Pooja said that she wrote novels'.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• We make changes in tenses of reported speech only when the reporting verb is in the past tense.
 
• When the reported speech is an assertive sentence, we follow these steps-
 
 
• Reporting verb 'said to' is changed into told. 
 
• connector 'that' is used in place of commas.
 
• Tense of reported speech is changed accordingly. (in above sentence- 'write' changes into 'wrote')
 
• personal Pronouns of reported speech are changed as per subject and object of reporting verb. Here, the first person- 'I' will change into 'she' as per **subject** - 'Pooja'.
 
 

Therefore, the correct sentence is- *" Pooja said that she wrote novels."*
